xs.description: Extra small breakpoint for portrait phones (min-width: 0). Bootstrap's default mobile-first starting point.

sm.description: Small breakpoint for landscape phones (≥576px). First responsive breakpoint in Bootstrap's mobile-first approach.

md.description: Medium breakpoint for tablets (≥768px). Common tablet viewport size for responsive layouts.

lg.description: Large breakpoint for desktops (≥992px). Standard desktop viewport size for responsive web design.

xl.description: Extra large breakpoint for large desktops (≥1200px). Wide desktop viewport for expansive layouts.

xxl.description: Extra extra large breakpoint for larger desktops (≥1400px). Widest default viewport for ultra-wide displays.
